review: It's CHEAP looking. THANKFULLY I'm using it outside in the patio for fresh cut flowers, but I'd never use this indoors on my kitchen table or in the dining room or ANYWHERE inside my house.
title: cheap, and I mean CHEAP dollar store vase. Very disappointed.

review: This Bestier Kitchen Bakers Rack was no good. The fake wood split into when it fell from the box. I immediately returned it back to the company. The only reason I gave it a star was so that I could post my comment. Don't waste your money. Rack is cheaply made as well.
title: Very disappointed!!!

review: not much sticking power so very easy to remove will not stick to anything with a texture total waste for what I wanted but will use on the spice rack.
title: not much sticking power

review: I want to give this a better review. But, I can’t. The reason is that it is not durable. I overturned it on my kitchen table and the sprayer broke off the bottle. There was no distance to this and it was warm in the house. There was no reason for it to break. The product is going to need to become more durable if it is going to fit into an everyday use mode. Until I broke it, I was going to give it four or five stars. But, this will not work in an everyday environment. I wish it would.
title: Not durable at all!!

review: Does not pick up crumbs. I ordered this due to taking care if a disabled person who drops crumbs everywhere. It also gets stuck underneath my hutch and kitchen island.
title: Not what I hoped for.

review: These bar stools took forever to assemble. It was a nightmare for my husband to put them together. Honestly, they weren’t worth the hassle. We are currently using them in our kitchen. They have a basic comfort level and durability. We have laminate floors in our kitchen apartment and these bar stools leave black marks on the floors. It’s easy to clean off, but annoying nonetheless.
title: Took FOREVER to assemble!

review: We have a new screened porch and added a dining table - these work well but you need to get the hang of holding down the lid as you use it.
title: for coordinated people

review: Loved the pattern. For the kitchen table. Fits well. Could have a little more flannel but it’s good.
title: Loved the pattern

review: These little turkeys are easy to put together and look very cute on your Holiday table Or as a decoration on your kitchen island.
title: Cute

review: Functional and Priced Right. Extremely easy to put together, looks pretty good, and has a fair storage capacity.
title: Spice rack it's functional and Priced Right

review: Looks really cute on the wall as a spice rack. The design is nice. I like the glass which keeps it lighter looking. I would have given this 5 starts, except the doors don't quite line up, etc. But............. for the money, and what I needed it is PERFECT!
title: Looks cute....

review: These look really elegant and they are comfortable to sit on. I keep them tucked under my kitchen island. They are counter height, not bar height. My husband assembled them in 5 minutes. All the hardware is included. He is 275lb and is hesitant to use them. The metal won’t withstand that weight for very long. I’m 150lb and feel absolutely safe and sturdy in them. The metal legs do make an awful sound when being pulled out. I need to put little caps on the bottom to quiet them down!
title: Comfortable but not for heavier people

review: I like this more than I thought I would. Directions say to wash warm and NOT DRY IN DRYER. This was a problem. I hung over bar stools but thought “what would ppl do without that option?” It air dried beautifully. It had a YKK zipper, awesome!! Only the top is seersucker. The bottom is just sheen-fabric. Cat hair sticks to it & it tends to get static-y. Still, I love the look and quality of stitching etc look great!
title: Surprisingly I like it.

review: Great value. These chairs are just as they are pictured. Needed to replace my old casual dining chairs so took a chance and ordered these as I love Amazon's service and return policy. If you need sturdy chairs these are for you. Gave only a 4 as the packaging was damaged but luckily not the chairs. These chairs fit a 300 lb man and didn't bend or give!
title: Great value. These chairs are just as they are ...

review: A few years ago, I bought a couple of ghost chairs on Amazon and I love them! So I decided to add to my look by purchasing two backless bar stools. I am happy with them. Good product for the price.
title: I bought a couple of ghost chairs on Amazon and I love them! So I decided to add to my ...

review: This chair is aesthetically pleasing to the eye. I love the look! It’s very modern/contemporary. The seat and back are khaki twill which is surrounded by expresso colored wood. It is well padded and comfortable. Why then the reduction in the overall rating? Well, this bar/counter stool isn’t tall enough for my bar area and too tall for my kitchen table. So while comfortable and attractive, I didn’t find it to be very functional, at least in my kitchen. So before purchasing carefully measure your space to make sure that it will work for you. 3.5-4 stars
title: I love the look

review: This item is an industrial style dining table. Assembly was very straight forward and easy. There is a metal base that you attach the legs to, then you attach the cross bar, then screw everything into the table top and it's done. The item is very sturdy. The wood table top is really thick. However, mine had a knick in the wood on the side. The size is perfect for a small dining space. It would fit four chairs around and there is enough space for four people to dine at the table.
title: Dining table

review: At 72 inches long, this is long enough to span the length of our our kitchen table with the center leaf installed (it forms a 6 person table). The color is consistant and provides a nice clean, classic look.
title: Neat classic look

review: Very tall table but fits perfectly in a space where any kitchen island could go. My bar stools were way too short for this table so I had to buy new 39-42 height chairs. However small inconvenience. Very sturdy and looks great in the breakfast area
title: Fantastic table for a small space

review: Omg....I love Gnomes And to now find A Christmas tree 1 I'm happiest can be! And it even has lights !!! This is so cute and it is pretty tall so I put it on my kitchen island and it looks awesome. Everyone that came in for the holidays and saw that mention how cute it was.
title: So cute

review: These little jars were exactly what I needed to an antique spice rack that I picked up that was missing its jars. Holds a good amount of spice. Easy to clean and refill. Comes with a little funnel to help top up when getting low. Sturdy glass and well fitting tops. I even dropped one on our stone floor and it didn't crack or smash. Very impressed!
title: The perfect spice jar!

review: I bought this to hold fruits and vegetables in the small space between my refrigerator and kitchen table. Fits perfectly not bulky but very useful. Currently I have in the top basket avocados, the second basket is holding 3lbs of onions and my bottom basket fits and holds a 10lb bag of potatoes. No tipping or spilling so convenient.
title: Cute and functional

review: It was so easy to install and is quite sturdy. Finally got all my spices organized, makes it easy to see and find what I’m looking for. Really love it.

review: These bar stools look very nice and were easy to assemble. A larger base might add to the sturdiness.

I didn't get over to see her this past weekend, but I will this coming week or weekend. It was a hit. Thank you.
title: and she loved the idea

review: LOVE THIS STOOL!! It is comfortable & the price was not bad! Built strong & sturdy!! Very happy with it!! Would buy again!!

review: Great as an indoor smokeless grill. I cook with it almost every night and great for breakfast eggs, hash browns, and meat (bacon or sausage). I grill many veggies on it also. It's just a super grill anyway you use it. I have it on a kitchen island and it's ready to go any time I need it. Easy clean up also ( and I don't have a dishwasher). The price was reasonable when I bought it at Amazon.
title: It's a great smokeless indoor grill

review: Great decor piece for the kitchen table . Just change items in the truck with the season

review: I just moved to a new place and in need of a dining table. I got this one because the pattern looks super cool! I was so surprised by how good the quality is when I assemble it. It is easy to assemble and it only takes me about half hour to get everything set. It’s a perfect size but it can fit my whole family.
title: Great quality

review: This is so elegant for my dinning table! I love it. I will use this on my Christmas dinner and it makes my glass dining table look so elegant!

The shelves are packaged beautifully and no damage to the finish or the metal. Easily hung with INCLUDED hardware and ideal for a small spice rack I wanted for frequently used spices in the kitchen. The second one I hung inside the door of the pantry for seasoning packages and both have worked out beautifully. Love the vintage color and the 'curly-ques' that blend well with our farmhouse style kitchen.
title: Wall Mount Single tier mesh spice shelf

review: just perfect for what I needed, beautiful colors and fit on my round dining table.
title: Beautiful and just what I needed.

review: We don't use these daily so I can't say with major wear & tear how they will hold up but with moderate use they are doing great after a few months! They are super comfortable, very easy to assemble, & look very high end.

review: Ordered, received with minor problem, contacted Linon which responded immediately with superb customer service. Bar stools made to order and completely satisfactory. Great job from vendor as well as AMAZON.

review: This sprays my olive oil perfectly, no more buying aerosol cans, large enough to hold a decent amount of oil, but small enough to fit on my spice rack shelf near the stove, 5 stars

review: This table set was very sturdy and fits into a large or small kitchen area. It arrived on time and was a great value for the money.

I hand wash these -- no problems at all with quality (no flaking, etc.). And they hold a decent amount of wine. Very happy with these.

review: I installed it into a stud and it is great for holding all of my spices!

Each shelf has a lip to keep things on the shelf. It looks good. It's sturdy and it holds a lot. Excellent product.

review: Gorgeous containers. These are a perfect size for even a display on a dining table during the holidays. A lot of bling in these. Perfect and well made. So versatile!

review: I used to buy my wife flowers every week to keep on the dining room table, but during Covid we had to take a break. I'm SO HAPPY we found this! It looks so nice and pretty on the table, my wife actually loves it and wants me to get another for the kitchen table as well! Unlike real flowers, they will always look great and never wilt or need maintenance. I highly recommend it as a part of your decor.

review: Ridiculously good quality for the price. They’re extremely comfortable and well made. I bought them for my sons new home for the ends of his dining table. They are beautiful and look like the ones I paid thousands for at a high end furniture store for my home. Amazon did well on these.

review: Nice trivets. Pretty, durable, and keep me from scorching or leaving rings on my quartz countertops... And my dining table.

review: Perfect size and shape for a spice rack. I was able to mount over stove to create counter space and free up a cabinet in the kitchen. Wood is pretty and easy to install.

review: This looked great on our long, white dining table with Halloween decor. We got lots of compliments. It works perfectly with our black and white theme. Good fabric and design.

review: The size is wonderful - and the glass is so pretty as it catches the light. We’re trying all kinds of fall arrangements in it - difficult to say what looks best! We have it at our fireplace now, but it looked great on the large dining table, too - We’re having fun moving it around! Good choice!
title: Wow - it’s beautiful!

review: Suitable for many things - on the dining table holding all the condiments, on a desk, keeping the surface clutter-free; it looks good, is sturdy - was easy to assemble. Good choice!

Great for iced water - will look beautiful on the dining table. Very pleased with the multi-purpose carafe.

review: We use this on our deck dining table - it always got compliments. It washed well and spots were easy to remove. Looked great with our white dishes. It came out of the dryer ready for use - no ironing required. Good choice.

review: This is a well crafted, elegant and practical spice rack. I have a small getaway condo and this rack fitted perfectly over the cooking range, saving me valuable counter space. It has a much larger capacity than most spice racks and can accommodate the usual range of spice containers. This spice rack will also last forever ! I love it and highly recommend it !!

review: They were too large for my spice rack but found other uses in my craft room for them.
title: Not what I was expecting, but still very happy

review: This is the best spice rack ever. Fits nicely in the cupboard, and I can find all my items easily.
title: Very pleased!

review: I loooove these salt cellars. Nice and big. Glass is thick and looks almost like crystal. Gorgeous. No more bamboo formaldahyde. I can't believe people put toxic chemicals where food should be. I truly hate these people. Anyways, the price is the best and it's a 2 pack, so, one in kitchen, and one on dining table. It cracks me up why anyone would complain about having 2, or, about the size. Eye roll city.
title: Finally!

review: We used this above our kitchen island to bring so extra Christmas cheap. Comes with a remote that works well and you can change the setting to some diffferent lighting option. Not too bright so can’t light up a whole room but can set a great Christmas mood

review: This attractive set is made to fit any decor. It is a fine quality, simple in design and especially made of porcelain. Included is a small white spoon. My set sits on my new kitchen island. It can fit and look great at the dining room.
title: Fits.... and looks great in kitchen or dining room.

review: Well, what you get is a 4 piece Flatware set, and yes, it is stainless steel. The set is fine quality, and better yet, it looks good on the table. I prefer not to put mine through the dishwasher and since it is 4 pieces, I hand wash them. There are versatile uses for each set. But, now all you need is another set......at least for two people. The set will look very attractive on the dining table. Get more!
title: Really fine quality set!

review: This Chita bar stool is gorgeous. I love the design – very modern and sleek. There was no assembly – this chair came assembled. Just remove the shipping wrap and voila. You have a fully assembled chair. The black leather back is quilted in diamond shapes, and the legs are brass color. It is very comfortable. My only criticism is that this bar stool is not high enough for my bar, so it will be an extra chair for my kitchen table. Otherwise, it is perfect. 4.5 stars.
title: Elegant bar stool (4.5 to 5 stars).

review: These two gold, foam snowflakes are going to be perfect for the holidays. These decorative pieces are lightweight and versatile. I have several uses in mind for them. I can use these to decorate my front door; place over my bar in the kitchen; place over the kitchen table; or place on the table as decorations; or finally place them on the hearth of the fireplace. These are the perfect holiday decorations! And for the price (under $20), who can beat them.
title: Perfect for the holidays!

review: I used for my commercial bakers rack in my kitchen to keep small stuff from catching on the metal and it is awesome. Well worth the money.
title: Worth the money

review: I cook a lot and am willing to buy a new spice if a new recipe requires something I don' t have. As such I have a LOT of spice bottles. I have several of these lazy susans and they are perfect for me. I do arrange my spices alphabetically (ocd thank you very much) and line these up. I can spin them around so I can easily find what I'm looking for. They don't require a lot of maintenance so that a plus and the insides are non-slip so the bottles don't slide around.
title: My version of a spice rack

review: I ordered a 'Kamenstein 16 Jar Hourglass Acacia Spice Rack' for review. This spice rack is absolutely stunning. It is beautifully designed and the Acacia wood is solid. It is made extremely well and spins smoothly. The quality definitely meets the price point. I have yet to actually use the spices included but as they are dried I foresee no issues with them. Overall, this is a beautifully done spice rack that I am proud to display in my kitchen.
title: Beautifully Made

review: Beautiful long candle bowl set. Something that really stands out, whether be on the dining table or a party table. Especially great for parties. Recommended
title: Beautiful candle bowl set

review: Got this to protect dining chairs from new kitten. Works perfectly! Easy on, easy off! No damage from pets, Great price... what else could i ask for!
title: Great!

review: The spice rack was sturdy and great overall, however, I was unable to use it due to the depth of my cabinets.
title: Nice Concept!

review: Seems like a nice spice rack. Some assembly required for sure Doesn’t look hard though - it seems like a decent instruction set and the tools provided could be enough I like the design overall. Looks nice and the wood finish is pretty
title: Nice for spices

review: Nice spice rack. It fit my bbq rubs well and without issue. All my stuff can be nicely organized now. I liked the design and the different mounting options. This seems a good idea to keep things organized
title: Nice for my bbq rub

review: I'm a wheelchair user so I decided to move my spices to a more convenient spot that I can reach easily. This is perfect because I could mount it wherever I wanted. I decided to use the sticky pads rather than the anchors that needed to be needed to be drilled in. This allowed me to install them on the side of my kitchen island without doing any damage. It's very sturdy and holds all of my glass jars easily.
title: Strong and sturdy
